play-chess.heroTitle: Play Chess at Hobsons Bay Chess Club
play-chess.heroDescription: Club nights, social chess and tournaments for adults and older juniors in Melbourne’s West

sections.heading: Who Can Play?
sections.intro: Our Play Chess program is designed for adults and older juniors who want regular, organised chess – from relaxed social games to serious rated tournaments.

sections.heading: Club Nights - Weekly Competitive Chess
sections.intro: HBCC runs regular classical and rapid tournaments on our club nights. These events are structured, paired rounds where you’ll be matched against players of similar strength over multiple weeks.
icons: When: Tuesdays from around 7:15pm until late.
Format: Classical or rapid events depending on the term.
Pairings: Swiss-system pairings managed on our tournament site.
Who: Suitable for adults and older juniors comfortable with clocks and notation.

sections.heading: Social Nights - Chess Without the Pressure
sections.intro: Social nights are relaxed, non-competitive gatherings designed for chess enthusiasts of all skill levels. No clocks, no stress – just friendly games at your own pace.
icons: Casual atmosphere – focus on enjoying the game.
Open to all levels – perfect for beginners and casual players.
Meet fellow enthusiasts and make new friends.
Optional tips and guidance from experienced players and coaches.

sections.heading: Tournaments & Ratings How It Works
sections.intro: If you’re new to organised chess, the terminology can be confusing. Here’s a simple guide to the types of events we run and how ratings work.

sections.heading: How to Get Started
sections.intro: Getting started at HBCC is simple. Follow these steps and we’ll take care of the rest.

sections.heading: Ready to Play?
sections.intro: Join us for a social night or club event and discover why HBCC is the home of chess in Melbourne’s West.

juniors.heroTitle: Juniors Chess at Hobsons Bay Chess Club
juniors.heroDescription: Fun, structured chess coaching and tournaments for kids in Melbourne’s West. Building skills, confidence and character on and off the board.

sections.heading: Who Is Our Juniors Chess For?
sections.intro: HBCC welcomes juniors of all abilities – from absolute beginners to strong tournament players.

sections.heading: A Clear Pathway from Beginner to Competitive Chess
sections.intro: HBCC offers a simple, progressive pathway that supports juniors as they grow from beginners into confident, competitive players.

sections.heading: Programs & Levels
sections.intro: We offer Junior Coaching where we group juniors by experience (not by age) so every child is challenged at the right level in a supportive environment.

sections.heading: Weekly Tournament & Coaching Schedule
sections.intro: Our Juniors coaching program runs parallel to school terms. Our Junior tournaments and social nights happen all through the year including school holidays. Exact term dates and special events are published in our Juniors Calendar.

sections.heading: Junior Tournaments & Ratings
sections.intro: Tournaments are a fun and important part of a junior’s development. They build resilience, sportsmanship, and help juniors apply what they learn in coaching.

sections.heading: Coaching & Support Team
sections.intro: Our juniors are supported by experienced coaches and volunteers who are passionate about teaching chess in a safe, encouraging environment.

sections.heading: Information for Parents
icons: Safety & Supervision: Juniors are supervised by coaches and volunteers during sessions. We aim to provide a safe, welcoming environment for every child.
Behaviour & Fair Play: We expect respectful behaviour, good sportsmanship and fair play. Parents and juniors should review our Code of Conduct and club policies.
Drop-off & Pick-up: Please arrive on time, sign in if required, and ensure your child is collected promptly after the session ends.
Communication: Important updates are shared via email and our club platforms. If you have questions, contact the Juniors Coordinator.

sections.heading: How to Enrol
sections.intro: HBCC offers a simple, progressive pathway that supports juniors as they grow from beginners into confident, competitive players.

sections.heading: Ready to Get Your Child Started?
sections.intro: Enrol in our Juniors program and give your child the chance to learn, play and grow with one of Melbourne’s most active chess clubs.

tournaments.heroTitle: Tournaments at Hobsons Bay Chess Club
tournaments.heroDescription: From friendly club events to flagship open tournaments – compete, improve and enjoy great chess in Melbourne’s West.

sections.heading: Flagship Events
sections.intro: HBCC runs several major tournaments across the year, designed for different ages and competitive levels.

sections.heading: Club Competitions
sections.intro: Across the year we run seasonal competitions that help members improve through regular, structured play.
icons: Rapid series and themed events (e.g., Swiss nights, mini-tournaments).
Junior term events and rating-focused tournaments.

sections.heading: How Our Tournaments Work
sections.intro: If you’re new to organised chess, don’t worry we keep it friendly and structured.

sections.heading: Venue & Tournament Rules
sections.intro: To ensure a great experience for everyone, please review the venue rules and tournament expectations before attending.
icons: Start times: Please arrive early; late arrivals may receive a default time penalty depending on the event rules.
Mobile phones: Must be switched off or set to silent and stored as per arbiter instructions.
Behaviour: Respect opponents, arbiters and venue staff. Parents should support a positive junior environment.
Fair play: We follow standard chess rules and fair-play expectations, especially for rated events.

sections.heading: Ready to Compete?
sections.intro: View upcoming tournaments, register online, and join a welcoming chess community in Melbourne's West.
